subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should Telegram/ACP source turns enforce an action-verification or fail-closed policy when final text claims completed side effects without matching tool evidence?
rationale: The current code has tool lifecycle facts and delivery policy hooks, but deciding whether to suppress, retry, warn, or document unsupported claims changes user-visible behavior and compatibility for existing chat agents.

options.title: Define verification policy
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved policy that maps completed tool evidence to final visible claims and chooses the recovery behavior for mismatches.

options.title: Scope to stranded replies only
options.body: Let #85714/#99536 handle missing message delivery and keep arbitrary claimed side-effect verification out of core for now.

options.title: Document current limitation
options.body: Document that chat agents can still claim unsupported side effects and point users to PostToolUse-style diagnostics or stricter agent prompts.

recommendation.title: Define verification policy
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved policy that maps completed tool evidence to final visible claims and chooses the recovery behavior for mismatches.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent product-policy and merge activity on the closest source-reply/message_tool_only mitigation makes this the best available decision owner.
